title: Episode 82: Trending — Substantial under-detection of human rabies cases in the United States
itunes_title: Trending — Substantial under-detection of human rabies cases in the United States
description:
**Top Trending Friday** — our weekly pick of the top-trending paper on r/science this week.

**[Substantial under-detection of human rabies cases in the United States](https://doi.org/10.1038/s44528-026-00031-4)**

*Communications Health, 2026*

DOI: [10.1038/s44528-026-00031-4](https://doi.org/10.1038/s44528-026-00031-4)

**Question:** Using rabies-infected organ donors as an accidental sample of US deaths, how many human rabies deaths does routine surveillance actually miss?

**Answer:** Three of 239,251 deceased donors (2000–2024) died of undiagnosed rabies; scaling that ratio to all US deaths yields ~856 estimated undiagnosed rabies deaths (95% CI 213–2220), versus 2.4 confirmed per year — suggesting only ~7% detection. The estimate rests entirely on assuming donors carry average national rabies risk, an assumption the authors themselves show would be undermined by only a 14-fold risk elevation among donors.

**Three takeaways**

1. Three of 239,251 deceased donors died of undiagnosed rabies; scaled to 68 million US deaths, that implies ~34.2 undiagnosed rabies deaths/year against 2.4 confirmed.
2. The whole estimate hinges on donors having average national rabies risk; the authors calculate that a 14-fold higher donor risk would erase the discrepancy.
3. The 213–2220 confidence interval reflects only Poisson noise from three events, not the larger uncertainty from donor-selection bias.

source_metadata.title: Substantial under-detection of human rabies cases in the United States
source_metadata.abstract: Based on multiple instances of human-to-human rabies transmission via organ or tissue transplantation from initially undiagnosed rabies-infected donors, we estimate 856 (213-2220) human rabies deaths in the United States (US) from 2000 to 2024, meaning that only around 7% of human rabies deaths in the US were confirmed during this period.
